changedCount: {count, plural, =0 {no settings changed} one {# setting changed} other {# settings changed}}
textIntro: Choose the font for your headings and for your text. The rest sets itself.
airHelp: The colour placed behind a heading or a text (Banner, Highlight): tight against the letters, or with more room. Each text can pick its own.
textAdvancedHint: The caption font, then the style of each text on the site (font, weight, italics, letter case, letter spacing).
captionsHelp: Labels and captions of the works.
paperIntro: Choose the background of your pages, then the space between blocks.
wallpaperHint: My wallpaper: your drawn patterns, to repeat behind a page, a large block or the cards. You pick them from the page, block or card concerned.
drawHint: You can also draw your own paper in Photoshop (“Draw in Photoshop”, at the top of the page): it will appear here with its settings.
spacingHelp: The space between sections and at the sides of the pages.
spacingPrecise: This theme has precise spacing (fine-tuned below), close to “{label}”. It is kept as it is: choose a level to replace it.
spacingAdvancedHint: The spacing in rem and the maximum width of the content.
betweenSectionsHelp: On a large screen; halved on mobile.
shapesIntro: Choose the shape of the site's elements, then how round the corners are.
noLayers: This theme has no layers: the “Layered depth” opening shows without any depth.
roundHelp: A single setting for the corners of buttons, cards, blocks and images: from square to very round.
roundPrecise: This theme has precise roundness (fine-tuned below), close to “{label}”. It is kept as it is: choose a step to replace it.
roundAdvancedHint: The corner radii one by one, in pixels, and the shape of the buttons.
imageFailed: “{name}”: the image could not be prepared.
logoImported: Logo imported: it keeps its colours. Save to keep it.
logoIntro: Your logo replaces your name written at the top left of every page.
noLogo: No logo yet: your name is written as text in the header. Import an image, or draw your logo in Photoshop.
drawInPhotoshop: Draw it in Photoshop → open the kit
removeLogo: Remove the logo (go back to the written name)
logoFormatHelp: PNG or WebP on a transparent background, cropped close to the drawing: that looks best.
keepColorsHelp: The logo is shown as it was drawn or imported.
useTextColorHelp: Only the shape is kept: the logo is drawn like your text, in its colour.
lostColors: A logo saved before this version may have lost its colours: import it again to get them back.
cursorHint: The mouse cursor is also drawn in the Photoshop kit.
